setup.scope: five paper shapes, bf16, HM P32/P64 and matched M1N16; no automatic promotion
setup.policy: three-round medians, first group attempt passing validity and canary <=1.15; no selection by latency; at most three attempts; baseline/candidate process order alternates by unit; official/recovery arms alternate within groups

coverage.not_remeasured: Other five LM shapes, small/medium recovery workloads, fp32 timing/accuracy appendix

policy: Use candidate absolute measurements and same-campaign official Mamba 1 comparisons. Retained storage unchanged. No extrapolation beyond the five measured shapes.
